profile.name: Spectra III 光源引擎
profile.description: 用于显微成像与荧光实验的多通道激发光源系统，可通过串口连接并管理多个颜色通道。各通道可对应 LED、发光光导或激光，用于为样品提供不同波段的照明。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel excitation light source system for microscopy and fluorescence experiments. It connects over a serial port and manages multiple color channels. Individual channels may correspond to LEDs, luminescent light pipes, or lasers to provide illumination at different wavelengths.
